name: Ablating
description: Major Goetic Art Virtue that opens the Ablating Art at 0; combined with Summoning it lets a sorcerer leech away the power of a demon or spirit.

name: Binding
description: Major Goetic Art Virtue opening the Binding Art, used with Summoning to force a demon or incorporeal spirit into a physical object or person.

name: Commanding
description: Major Goetic Art Virtue opening the Commanding Art, allowing a sorcerer combined with Summoning to make summoned demons obey him.

name: Summoning
description: Major Goetic Art Virtue giving the primary Art of the Ars Goetia; combined with other Goetic Arts it binds, destroys and controls demons and spirits.

name: Amorphous
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Tainted Virtue letting the character take any non-specific human form, as his body has the almost-gaseous property of demonic flesh.

name: Aptitude for (Sin)
description: Minor General Tainted Virtue granting +3 to rolls in a narrow circumstance linked to a demon's Obsession, such as picking pockets or poisoning.

name: Chthonic Magic
description: Major Hermetic Supernatural Virtue making a magus's magic dark and sinister, granting the Chthonic Magic Ability at 1 and benefits from the Infernal realm.

name: Command Animals
description: Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue letting the character mentally command mundane animals of a species associated with the demon who tainted him.

name: Consumption
description: Major Unholy Power Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Consumption at 1.

name: Convoluted Mind
description: Minor General Tainted Virtue giving +3 to Infernal Lore rolls to predict demons and a Common Sense-like feeling when dealing with demons.

name: Corruption
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting infernalists teach corrupted knowledge; grants the Corruption Ability at 1.

name: Ceremony
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting the character lead or join dark rituals of the maleficia; grants the Ceremony Ability at 1.

name: Debauchery
description: Major Unholy Method Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Debauchery at 1.

name: Demonic Blood
description: Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue for a character with a demon parent, giving Infernal Might (Corpus) 5, Infernal Powers, an attendant ruach and a shortened lifespan.

name: Demonic Might
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue available only with Demonic Blood that increases Infernal Might by 2.

name: Demonic Powers
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue for demon-blooded characters granting an extra 20 levels of Infernal Powers.

name: Devil Child
description: Special free Mythic Companion Virtue for a character born of demonic parents; taken in place of The Gift.

name: Diablerie
description: Major Unholy Power Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Diablerie at 1.

name: Diabolist
description: Special free Virtue for a Mythic Companion who has given over his soul to the Infernal realm.

name: Effusion
description: Major Unholy Power Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Effusion at 1.

name: Enticer of Multitudes
description: Minor General Tainted Virtue, a version of Inspirational usable only to manipulate groups toward evil acts.

name: Gender Shift
description: Minor Supernatural Tainted Virtue letting the character change gender each midnight.

name: Hermetic Sorcery
description: Major Hermetic Tainted Virtue: studying Goetic Arts also yields Rego experience, and studying supernatural Lores yields Vim experience.

name: Hex
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting the character curse enemies with dire predictions; grants the Hex Ability at 1.

name: Immune to Disease
description: Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue marking the character as property of a powerful demon so that lesser disease demons refuse to harm him.

name: Infernal Blessing
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Tainted Virtue granting 60 or 120 levels of beneficial unholy effects from a demon or Infernal tradition.

name: Infernal Heirloom
description: Minor Supernatural Tainted Virtue giving a magical item inherited from a diabolist, whose use draws the owner closer to the demon that made it.

name: Incantation
description: Major Unholy Method Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Incantation at 1.

name: Malediction
description: Major Unholy Power Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Malediction at 1.

name: Mentored by Demons
description: Minor General Tainted Virtue giving 50 extra experience points from demonic teachers, who teach only Abilities that suit their plans.

name: Phantasm
description: Major Unholy Power Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Phantasm at 1.

name: Psychomachia
description: Major Unholy Power Virtue granting the Supernatural Ability Psychomachia at 1.

name: Sense Passions
description: Major Supernatural Virtue letting the character see into hearts and minds; grants the Sense Passions Ability at 1.

name: Summoner
description: Special free Virtue for a Mythic Companion trained as a sorcerer's apprentice.

name: Tainted Treasure
description: Minor General Tainted Virtue granting cursed wealth that can only be spent sinfully and ruins non-sinful ventures.

name: Corrupted Abilities
description: Minor Supernatural Tainted Flaw: Abilities taught by a Watcher or corrupted source gain +3 for sinful uses and -3 for selfless ones.

name: Corrupted Arts
description: Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: a Hermetic Art studied from a corrupted source gives +3 for sinful uses and -3 for selfless ones.

name: Corrupted Spells
description: Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: at least 30 levels of formulaic spells learned from a corrupted source, favoring sinful use.

name: Demonic Familiar
description: Minor Story Flaw binding the character to a famulus, a demon that possesses an animal and is not loyal to her.

name: Depraved
description: Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character seeks to undermine religion and avoids the Dominion.

name: Evil Destiny
description: Major Story Flaw: the Infernal realm has taken an unknown interest in the character, used by the storyguide in secret.

name: False Power
description: Major Supernatural Tainted Flaw making one Supernatural Virtue also Infernally associated, so it appears unholy under investigation.

name: Impious Friend
description: Minor Story Tainted Flaw: a minor demon poses as the character's friend to guide him to a tragic destiny.

name: Manufactured Ignorance
description: Minor Story Tainted Flaw: a Delusion sustained by minor demons who supply supporting evidence.

name: No Tradition
description: Minor General Flaw for an infernalist who belongs to no Infernal tradition and so has no favored Abilities.

name: Repellent
description: Major General Tainted Flaw: the character bears a physical feature of his demonic creator, imposing -6 on trust rolls.

name: Tainted Offspring
description: Major Story Tainted Flaw: the character's child has been marked by a powerful demon for great but unpleasant things.

name: Tragic Life
description: Major Story Flaw marking a tainted character whose life demons have manipulated to act predictably at a pivotal moment.

name: Vengeful Powers
description: Major Story Tainted Flaw: non-sinful use of the character's Powers causes harmful, often Infernal side effects.

name: Witch Marks
description: Minor General Tainted Flaw: minor disfigurements recognized by folk lore as marks of diabolists.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
description: Flaw taken by tainted characters who have rebelled against their demonic creator's design and incurred its enmity.

name: Tainted with Evil
description: Flaw often inherited by tainted people when demons distort the human too far.

name: Delusion
description: Flaw of mistaken belief; demon-blooded or tainted characters may have it to explain their abilities.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Flaw under which Demonic Weaknesses may be taken by Devil Children.

name: Plagued by an Angel
description: Story Flaw Devil Children often gain when targeted by Heaven's forces.

name: Supernatural Nuisance
description: Story Flaw Devil Children may gain when they come to Heaven's attention.

name: Disfigured
description: Inherited Flaw that can distance a tainted character from her designed destiny.

name: Age Quickly
description: Flaw that demon-blooded characters may not take.

name: Infamous
description: Flaw granting a bad Reputation, which cannot be combined with Infernal Reputations.

name: Proud
description: Personality Flaw appearing in example tainted characters such as Jochim and Malachi.

name: Weakness
description: Personality Flaw, e.g. Albert's weakness for flattery of friends.

name: Pious
description: Personality Flaw; Elspeth's is devoted to her demon's mock religion.

name: Monastic Vows
description: Flaw taken by Sister Andrea after taking vows at a nunnery.

name: The Gift
description: Virtue that makes magi; Mythic Companions and demon-blooded characters may not take it.

name: The False Gift
description: Corrupted version of The Gift, described in Chapter 12: Black Magic, for apprentices or magi marked by Hell.

name: Mythic Companion
description: Powerful non-Gifted companion who can rival a magus, receiving a Free Virtue and two Virtue points per Flaw point.

name: True Faith
description: Divine Virtue that beings with Might cannot take.

name: Faerie Blood
description: Faerie Virtue that beings with Might cannot take, and which can become a False Power.

name: Blood of the Nephilim
description: Divine-affiliated Virtue from Realms of Power: The Divine that beings with Might cannot take.

name: Diedne Magic
description: Supernatural Virtue that can be affected by the False Power Flaw.

name: Premonitions
description: Supernatural Virtue/Ability that can become a False Power vulnerable to demonic manipulation; Malachi has it.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural Virtue; its False version sees through deceptions when that leads to sin.

name: Shapeshifter
description: Supernatural Virtue; its False version only allows Infernal animal shapes such as cats, wolves, ravens or rats.

name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
description: Virtue (ArM5 p.67) that Sense Passions imitates in limited fashion.

name: Arcane Lore
description: Minor Virtue normally needed to learn Infernal Lore at character creation.

name: Unaging
description: Virtue that demon-blooded characters may not take.

name: Inspirational
description: Virtue of which Enticer of Multitudes is an evil version.

name: Common Sense
description: Virtue whose protective feeling is mirrored by Convoluted Mind for demons.

name: Wealthy
description: Major Virtue; Tainted Treasure could supply it, and Albert has it.

name: Greater Immunity
description: Major Virtue, e.g. Malachi's immunity to iron.

name: Puissant Guile
description: Minor Virtue required for all Devil Children.

name: Goetic Magic
description: Magic-affiliated supernatural ability referenced in Chapter 12.

name: False Magic
description: Magic-affiliated false Virtue referenced in Chapter 12.

name: False Faerie Blood
description: Faerie-affiliated false version of Faerie Blood.

name: Entrancement
description: Infernal-affiliated supernatural ability (ArM5 p.65).

name: Wise One
description: Virtue held by Elspeth the midwife.

name: Lesser Purifying Touch
description: Virtue held by Elspeth, for postnatal infections.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue held by Elspeth.

name: Landed Noble
description: Virtue held by Jochim.

name: Famous
description: Virtue held by Jochim as a commander of men.

name: Clerk
description: Virtue held by Sister Andrea.

name: Strong-willed
description: Virtue held by Sister Andrea.

name: Great Presence
description: Virtue Malachi has twice.

name: Privileged Upbringing
description: Virtue held by Malachi.

name: Puissant Leadership
description: Virtue held by Malachi.

name: Self-Confident
description: Virtue that Infernal Powers blessing can mimic; Malachi has it.

name: Venus's Blessing
description: Virtue held by Malachi.

name: Well-Traveled
description: Virtue held by Malachi.

name: Ceremony
description: Infernal Supernatural Ability letting a group of 13 (12 participants and a focus character) combine to empower an Infernal effect.

name: Chthonic Magic
description: Supernatural Ability learnable only by magi that draws on the Infernal; substitutes for Magic Theory in dark lab work and increases usable Infernal vis.

name: Consumption
description: Unholy Power Ability manipulating the energy of living things through dark rites.

name: Corruption
description: Supernatural Ability to lead others to evil unaware, via ceremonial and personal influence and teaching corrupted Abilities or Arts.

name: Debauchery
description: Unholy Method Ability focusing will through a strenuous physical act, using Stamina for maleficium rolls.

name: Diablerie
description: Unholy Power Ability to exert control over spirits, demons and the Infernal realm.

name: Effusion
description: Unholy Power Ability wielding power over the physical world, inorganic materials and natural forces.

name: Hex
description: Supernatural Ability to bring injury or ruin on enemies through declarations, signs or sympathetic representations, with a chosen delay.

name: Incantation
description: Unholy Method Ability invoking the Infernal through blasphemous words or writing, adding Communication and costing Confidence.

name: Malediction
description: Unholy Power Ability to punish enemies with diabolical curses.

name: Phantasm
description: Unholy Power Ability to create and control substantial demonic illusions.

name: Psychomachia
description: Unholy Power Ability to possess and distort the mind.

name: Sense Passions
description: Supernatural Ability to sense emotions, dominant Personality Traits and auras' tarnish, and in limited fashion holiness and unholiness.

name: True Name of (Being)
description: Placeholder for knowledge of a being's True Name, learned via (Realm) Lore, acting as a permanent Arcane Connection.

name: Infernal Lore
description: Arcane Ability about the Infernal; used to predict demons and resist corruption.

name: Dominion Lore
description: Supernatural Lore whose study grants Vim experience with Hermetic Sorcery.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Supernatural Lore whose study grants Vim experience with Hermetic Sorcery.

name: Magic Lore
description: Supernatural Lore whose study grants Vim experience with Hermetic Sorcery.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability for which Chthonic Magic can substitute in dark lab work.

name: Guile
description: Ability; Malachi has Guile 3+2.

name: Ablating
description: Goetic Art that leeches power from demons or spirits; described in Chapter 11: Ars Goetia.

name: Goetic Arts
description: The four sorcerous Arts of Ars Goetia: Ablating, Binding, Commanding and Summoning.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique gaining experience via Hermetic Sorcery when studying Goetic Arts.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form gaining experience via Hermetic Sorcery when studying Lores; Malachi's Power is Vim.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form; demon-blooded bodies contain Corpus vis and a profaned Host becomes Corpus vis.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form; profaned holy water yields unholy Aquam vis.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form of Malachi's mind-controlling Powers.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Technique; a Perdo Vim spell can remove hexes.

name: False Powers
description: Powers, including potentially Divine ones, tainted by Hell so they appear unholy, via botches or infernal interference.

name: Tainted Characters
description: People whose conception or upbringing demons meddled with, making them tools for Infernal schemes.

name: Tainted Virtues and Flaws
description: Category of Virtues and Flaws for demon-tainted characters; no more than half of starting Virtues or Flaws may be Tainted.

name: Unholy Methods
description: Category of Infernal Abilities (Debauchery, Incantation) used to activate maleficia.

name: Unholy Powers
description: Category of Infernal Abilities (Consumption, Diablerie, Effusion, Malediction, Phantasm, Psychomachia).

name: Maleficia
description: Infernal magic of unholy Methods and Powers described in Chapter 10.

name: Ars Goetia
description: Goetic sorcery of summoning and controlling demons, described in Chapter 11.

name: Black Magic
description: Dark Hermetic magic drawing on the Infernal, described in Chapter 12.

name: Infernal Traditions
description: Traditions of infernalists that teach Infernal Abilities, described in Chapter 13.

name: Might
description: Score marking a being as a member of a supernatural realm, granting Magic Resistance and immunity to Warping.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural change from which Might-bearing beings are immune; Infernal Warping can grant Infernal Virtues.

name: Twilight
description: Hermetic supernatural backlash from which beings with Might of that realm are immune.

name: Hubris
description: Supernatural backlash of a realm to which Might-bearing beings are immune.

name: Vituperation
description: Infernal backlash when an infernalist gains 2+ Warping Points or loses control of Infernal power, tormenting him as if in Hell.

name: Hierarchy Score
description: Score equal to an infernalist or demon's highest Reputation, representing authority over demons and used in Power formulas.

name: Infernal Reputation
description: Reputation representing what the forces of Hell think of a character; always considered beneficial.

name: Confidence
description: Score and points spent to fuel Incantation, Corruption and profaning; can rise after Vituperation.

name: Sacrifice
description: Ritual killing by infernalists to add a bonus (effigy to innocent human) to Power effect totals.

name: Profaning the Holy
description: Mystical abuse of a holy object to taint it and produce Infernal vis, costing a Confidence Point.

name: Vis
description: Magical power in physical form; profaning produces Infernal vis.

name: Vis Infesta
description: Type of Infernal vis usually produced by profaning.

name: Vis Sordida
description: Type of Infernal vis a particularly holy profaned object may become.

name: Vis Prava
description: Type of Infernal vis a very holy profaned object may even become.

name: Host
description: The body of Christ from the Eucharist; the most common object profaned in Mythic Europe, becoming Corpus vis.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Protection that forces of vengeance and hexes must penetrate; granted by Might.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural realm aura modifying Supernatural Abilities; Infernal auras boost Infernal Powers.

name: Tarnish
description: Infernal quality of an aura or soul that Sense Passions can detect.

name: Temper
description: Divine quality of an aura, counterpart to tarnish (Realms of Power: The Divine).

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link to a target used by Hex; a True Name acts as a permanent one.

name: True Names
description: Names of beings granting permanent Arcane Connection, discussed in Chapter 4: Infernal Legions.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Ritual that is the only way to slow the accelerated aging of demon-blooded characters.

name: Decrepitude
description: Aging measure; aging points still count toward it for demon-blooded characters.

name: Aging Table
description: Table for aging rolls; demon-blooded roll twice yearly after effective age 35.

name: Realm Affiliation
description: Association of supernatural Virtues, Flaws and Abilities with a realm for realm interaction purposes.

name: Infernalist
description: Person who deals with demons and the Infernal realm; Might-bearing beings who become infernalists gain Infernal Might.

name: Diabolist
description: One who has given his soul to Hell; creates infernal heirlooms and bears witch marks.

name: Infernal Ceremony
description: Unholy ritual of 13 participants empowered by the Ceremony Ability.

name: Demonic Weaknesses
description: Demon weaknesses (Chapter 4) that Devil Children may take as Lesser Malediction Flaws.

name: Obsession
description: A demon's defining sin, linked to Aptitude for (Sin) and Amorphous.

name: Sin
description: Moral failings that demons encourage; basis for Corruption and tainting.

name: Absolution
description: Divine sacrament that undoes hexes and can remove False Power.

name: Baptism
description: Sacrament withheld by diabolators to dedicate children to demons.

name: Forsaken Duration
description: Maleficia duration typically used for Infernal Blessing effects.

name: Infernal Ability
description: Common Infernal Blessing giving an unnatural bodily ability such as wings or fangs.

name: Infernal Confidence
description: Common Infernal Blessing granting an additional Confidence Point.

name: Infernal Device
description: Common Infernal Blessing providing a device with an unholy effect up to level 15.

name: Infernal Greatness
description: Common Infernal Blessing granting effects of a Major Virtue.

name: Infernal Health
description: Common Infernal Blessing giving +3 Aging rolls at the expense of a victim.

name: Infernal Powers (blessing)
description: Common Infernal Blessing granting effects of an appropriate Minor Virtue.

name: Infernal Protection
description: Common Infernal Blessing granting Magic Resistance 15.

name: Infernal Prowess
description: Common Infernal Blessing enhancing Soak, Damage, Initiative, Attack or Defense.

name: Focus Character
description: The participant in an Infernal Ceremony who possesses the required Supernatural Ability.

name: Group Modifier
description: Leaderless ceremony bonus equal to total Ceremony scores minus 13.

name: Infernal Realm
description: The realm of Hell and demons, which welcomes all and whose Powers are easy to gain.

name: Divine Realm
description: Realm of God; welcomes repentant defectors and whose agents meddle with Infernal plans.

name: Magic Realm
description: Supernatural realm; demon-blooded characters cannot be affiliated with it.

name: Faerie Realm
description: Supernatural realm; Hex and other Powers may be False Powers associated with Faerie.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine's presence in the world, avoided by Depraved characters and blocking Infernal Ability blessings.

name: Demon
description: Fallen angels cursed with a fallen nature; they taint children, teach, and plot against mankind.

name: Ruach
description: Minor demon attending a demon-blooded character, using its Misfortune Power against her enemies.

name: Famulus
description: Familiar demon that possesses an animal and can lend a character its senses.

name: Watcher
description: Demon type (Chapter 6: Demons as Deceivers) that teaches corrupted Abilities.

name: Incubus
description: Servile demon that carries semen to produce tainted children.

name: Order of Tempters
description: Weakest order of demons, to which children of female demons and human males always belong.

name: Nephilim
description: Humans with angelic ancestry; there is no Infernal equivalent since demon-blooded are sterile.

name: Phouka
description: Faerie that may become Infernal by delighting in tempting mortals to sin.

name: Lucifer
description: Leader of the fallen angels with whom demons fell.

name: Lickspitten
description: Example famulus described in Chapter 5.

name: Devil Children
description: Demon-blooded Mythic Companions created by powerful demons for a task, tragic but free-willed.

name: Albert
description: Example tainted merchant conceived under a demonic fever, guarded by a demon posing as the merchant Aldo.

name: Aldo
description: Minor demon masquerading as a merchant friend of Albert.

name: Elspeth
description: Example tainted midwife dedicated to a demon at birth, devoting newborns to her demon.

name: Jochim
description: Example tainted noble's son conceived by incubus for a pointless war before the Mongol invasion.

name: Sister Andrea
description: Example tainted rebel, niece of a sorcerer, who escaped her Manufactured Ignorance and lives in a nunnery.

name: Tiberius
description: Younger noble son guided by a demon posing as his grandfather's ghost, designed by Valefar as a snare for magi.

name: Valefar
description: Demon who designed Tiberius as a snare for magi.

name: Malachi
description: Devil Child created by the demon Abrigor to raise an army of darkness; raised by an English merchant.

name: Abrigor
description: Demon and False God who created Malachi.

name: Free the Devil's Servant
description: Malachi's Power that frees a trapped demon after sunset until dawn.

name: The Obedient Slave
description: Malachi's Power forcing any person to perform commanded tasks.

name: Unbridled Emotion of the Masses
description: Malachi's Power seizing up to a hundred targets with his current emotion.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Spell that keeps demons away; forces of Vengeful Powers cannot cross it.

name: Mongols
description: People a demon lord foresees invading the West.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The obscure order of wizards who can slow aging, which Tiberius hopes to serve.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting in which profaning the Host is common.

name: Eastern Church
description: Church whose icons infernalists might profane.

name: Crusaders
description: Might unintentionally profane Muslim holy places.

name: The Devil's Penance
description: Medieval German folk tale of a devil refusing humiliating penance.
